note: The Borromean rings problem (Cook's conjecture) concerns whether three unknotted space curves, not all circles, can be arranged to form the Borromean rings link. Cook's personal workshop page at Caltech contains compiled materials dating to early 1998, suggesting the conjecture was formulated around that time, but no explicit year of first posing is stated in available sources. The conjecture predates Howards' 2013-2014 papers on the topic. The exact year of first posing could not be definitively established from public sources.
